glosses: tray, platter (small, typically rectangular or round, flat, and rigid object upon which things are carried)

examples.text: Tenga cuidado, no deje caer la bandeja.
examples.en: Be careful. Don't drop the tray.

examples.text: Ella apiló las bandejas en el armario.
examples.en: She stacked the trays in the cupboard.

examples.text: Tom puso dos rebanadas de pan en la tostadora y bajó la bandeja.
examples.en: Tom put two slices of bread into the toaster and pushed down on the lever.
